description: This file contains a suite of test cases for the OpenClaw macOS application, including tests for various components such as Codable helpers, UI behaviors, shell execution, network port management, file system handling, and window management. It defines a test suite with multiple individual test functions to validate different functionalities of the application.

classes.name: LowCoverageHelperTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test functions to validate various components and functionalities of the OpenClaw macOS application.

methods.name: any codable helper accessors
methods.description: Tests for accessing and casting properties within the ProtoAnyCodable structure.

methods.name: attributed string strips foreground color
methods.description: Verifies that stripping foreground color attribute from an attributed string works correctly.

methods.name: view metrics reduce width
methods.description: Tests the reduction of view width between current and next values.

methods.name: shell executor handles empty command
methods.description: Ensures that executing an empty shell command fails gracefully.

methods.name: shell executor runs command
methods.description: Tests running a shell command that should succeed.

methods.name: shell executor times out
methods.description: Validates that a shell command times out appropriately.

methods.name: shell executor drains stdout and stderr
methods.description: Checks that stdout and stderr are fully captured during command execution.

methods.name: node info codable round trip
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of NodeInfo data structure.

methods.name: presence reporter helpers
methods.description: Verifies the presence reporter utility functions.

methods.name: port guardian parses listeners and builds reports
methods.description: Tests parsing of port listeners and building port reports.

methods.name: port guardian remote mode does not kill docker
methods.description: Ensures certain commands in remote mode are identified as expected without affecting Docker.

methods.name: port guardian local mode still rejects unexpected
methods.description: Tests rejection of unexpected commands in local mode.

methods.name: port guardian remote mode report accepts any listener
methods.description: Validates that remote mode reports accept all listeners.

methods.name: canvas scheme handler resolves files and errors
methods.description: Tests file resolution, error handling, and security checks in the CanvasSchemeHandler.

methods.name: canvas scheme handler blocks symlink escapes
methods.description: Ensures symbolic link escape attempts are detected and forbidden.

methods.name: menu context card injector inserts and finds index
methods.description: Tests insertion of custom menu items relative to existing items.

methods.name: canvas window helper functions
methods.description: Tests utility functions related to window frames, URL parsing, and IP address handling for CanvasWindowController.
